title: Engineering Data Security & R&D Architecture
subtitle: Technical overview distinguishing current Phase I BIM engineering data custody (client-provided CDEs and bilateral NDAs) from our planned Phase II cloud automation (target Q4 2027) and post-Phase II Edge AI R&D concepts (no announced release date).

scope_clarification.title: Architecture Scope & Dual-Zone Model
scope_clarification.client_zone_title: Zone 1: Current BIM Delivery & Post-Phase II On-Premise R&D
scope_clarification.client_zone_desc: Today (Phase I), pyBIM delivers BIM modeling, coordination, QA/QC, and local C#/Python Revit automation strictly within customer-provided CDEs and bilateral NDAs (pyBIM does not provide its own commercial cloud platform today). The air-gapped Edge AI topology shown below illustrates a conceptual Phase III R&D architecture; dedicated Phase III work starts after Phase II validation and is not currently commercially available.
scope_clarification.web_zone_title: Zone 2: Public Website & Inbound Services (Current Infrastructure)
scope_clarification.web_zone_desc: Hosted on Cloudflare Workers edge architecture. Public endpoints utilize Cloudflare Turnstile for privacy-preserving bot detection and Resend for transactional email notifications (Contact and ROI lead notifications).

block1.title: 1. Conceptual Network Isolation Topology (Phase III R&D)
block1.diagram_caption: Conceptual R&D Topology (Not Commercially Available): Future Phase III architecture explored for post-Phase II validation, illustrating isolated execution inside a client network.

rows.execution: Current BIM delivery operates within customer-provided CDEs under bilateral NDAs; planned Phase III R&D explores offline execution inside isolated client networks.
Phase I automation scripts run locally against project Revit files without sending model geometry to public third-party AI APIs.
Project engineering files stay in client-authorized repositories; the public website collects minimal voluntary enquiry data with published retention practices.

rows.requirement: BIM project data privacy & CDE integrity
rows.execution: Client Revit models and IFC files are managed exclusively through agreed client CDE channels governed by bilateral contracts and NDAs.

block3.title: 3. Engineering Data Custody & Future Edge AI Principles
block3.notice_title: PHASE I DELIVERY VS. PHASE III R&D BOUNDARY
block3.notice_text: "Today, client BIM data remains inside customer-provided CDEs and bilateral NDA environments while local Revit/Python tools run without sending geometry to public AI APIs. Sovereign Enterprise Edge AI is a future post-Phase II R&D architecture—not currently commercially available—designed around the principle of zero background telemetry."
block3.purge_title: CONCEPTUAL EPHEMERAL MEMORY DESIGN (PHASE III R&D)
block3.purge_text: In our planned Phase III R&D architecture (dedicated work begins after Phase II validation, with no announced release date), intermediate vectors are designed to stay in volatile memory and clear upon completion while models remain in the client's CDE.

block4.title: 4. Security Engineering & Infrastructure Protocols
block4.sector1_title: Private Automation & Cloud Connect (Phase I / Target 2027)

sector1_items.title: Encrypted Storage & Access Hygiene
sector1_items.text: Supports encrypted storage (AES-256) and isolated project workspaces for custom Phase I tooling and planned 2027 Cloud Connect modules.

sector1_items.title: Authenticated Transport Tunnels
sector1_items.text: Supports access control and encrypted administrative tunnels (such as WireGuard or Tailscale) where required by client IT policies.

block4.sector2_title: Future Edge Appliance Concept (Phase III R&D — No Date)

sector2_items.title: Hardened OS Research Architecture
sector2_items.text: Conceptual post-Phase II target architecture evaluating hardened Linux environments with mandatory access controls such as AppArmor or SELinux (not yet commercially available).

sector2_items.title: On-Premise Isolation Concept
sector2_items.text: Future R&D concept for local headless execution after Phase II completion and validation; not an active deployment offering or certified defense hardware.

sector3_items.title: Edge Delivery & Turnstile
sector3_items.text: Public website served globally via Cloudflare Workers serverless edge. Cloudflare Turnstile provides bot defense without tracking cookies.

sector3_items.title: Transactional Email (Resend)
sector3_items.text: Contact submissions and ROI lead notifications dispatched via Resend TLS-encrypted transactional APIs with payload validation.
